root_cause: The website had a sound Dutch SEO/order foundation and generated English routes, but English indexation, market-specific keyword ownership, localized revenue attribution, sitemap hreflang and locale-aware internal revenue linking were not one enforced production contract. The legacy keyword table also used keyword as a single primary key, which cannot represent the same term across multiple languages and markets.
prevention: Treat NL and EN as one bilingual commercial search estate with distinct market-specific keyword research.
Keep one canonical business intent owner and project localized metadata/landing canonicals from it.
Generate reciprocal hreflang in page metadata and sitemap after localized routes exist.
Project supporting-to-money, money-to-cluster and money-to-conversion links in both locales before release evidence.
Store keyword evidence by locale + market + keyword and prioritize it by search demand, CPC and intent without treating forecast value as realized revenue.
Close the loop through CTA, lead, proposal, order and realized revenue.
fix: Add a bilingual locale/revenue map for all canonical SEO owners, promote AI Modelwijzer as a commercial model-comparison owner, localize English metadata and owner attribution, add production bilingual revenue-link projection, include English canonicals with reciprocal hreflang in sitemap, validate the locale/revenue estate in the Netlify build, create locale/market keyword intelligence in Supabase, and feed that evidence into search/growth intelligence.
